correctness.rationale: Substitution t=-e^x reduces negative roots to an even scalar equation. One side is strictly increasing on x>0 and the other strictly decreasing, giving exactly one positive solution; strictness gives simplicity and evenness gives reciprocity. A two-scale Taylor expansion plus the implicit-function theorem yields the stated m^{-2} and m^{-4} terms. The argument uses the published exact Alexander polynomial and does not extrapolate from finite computation.
